summary:
Our project addresses the challenge by transforming forgotten space equipment into an engaging digital learning experience. Instead of focusing only on successful missions and active rovers, it highlights the historical and scientific importance of equipment that is no longer operating.
This project is important because these machines have contributed valuable knowledge about the Moon and Mars. Their discoveries continue to support scientific research and future exploration. By preserving their stories in an accessible digital platform, we aim to inspire students, space enthusiasts, and future explorers to appreciate the legacy of space exploration.
details:
Space Time Capsule is an interactive educational website designed as a digital museum about NASA equipment left on the Moon and Mars.
The website presents information about important space missions and equipment through different sections, including a Moon Explorer, Mars Explorer, mission stories, scientific discoveries and historical information.
Users can explore the Apollo Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP), Sojourner, Spirit and Opportunity. The website explains their purposes, achievements and contributions to space science.
The project was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Its simple and accessible design helps users explore information easily without requiring live interaction.
The main impact of this project is to create awareness about space exploration and show how scientific knowledge continues to benefit humanity even after a mission ends.
The project uses publicly available NASA mission information and references to support educational learning.
